sloka: नैवसाक्षुभ्यते देवी न च स्म परिदूयते ।न चास्या मुखवर्णस्य विक्रिया लक्ष्यते तदा ॥२-३५-३७॥
transliteration: naivasākṣubhyate devī na ca sma paridūyate ।na cāsyā mukhavarṇasya vikriyā lakṣyate tadā ॥2-35-37॥

translations.english: But that queen was not shaken at all, nor did she grieve; no alteration was then perceived in the colour of her face.
